audit.scope: Current uranium extraction observations and explicitly dated active-operation snapshots. Known gaps and approximate locations are retained; this is a reviewed contribution, not a complete world inventory.
audit.temporalPolicy: Actual production uses its stated year. Current operating-status snapshots are approximate and limited to 2026. No licence expiry, forecast, discovery, foundation or projected mine-life date is substituted for an observation. Annual intervals do not imply unbroken daily extraction.
audit.coordinatePolicy: Independent coordinate sources identify actual mine/deposit locations or explicitly named mining complexes, not country or town centres. Kazakh points are approximate regional-map digitizations; others retain their stated original source.

kazakhMapCalibration.precision: Regional operation symbols, several-kilometre spatial approximation; coordinates rounded to 0.001 degree do not imply metre accuracy.

omissions.reason: Closed/ceased-producing or construction/development-only as of reviewed sources. Historical phases remain elsewhere.
Current production evidence identified, but an independently defensible mine-level coordinate was not secured in this contribution. No city-centre substitute is supplied.
Additional primary operating evidence exists; precise independent site matching/coordinates remain incomplete. These are documented coverage gaps, not assertions of inactivity.
A processing plant or third-party ore throughput alone does not establish local uranium ore extraction.
Nichols Ranch restart is projected no earlier than 2027; Rosita restart is prospective Q4 2026, not an actual extraction observation as of this review.
